name: op_amp_buffer_stable
description: Unity-gain buffer with light (100 pF) capacitive load. Loop broken at U1/IN- (the sense pin — keeps the op-amp driving VOUT with its full load). Expect crossover near GBW=1 MHz with PM near 90° (dominant pole from A(f), parasitic pole at ~16 MHz from Rout·C_load contributes little). Phase never reaches -180° in the sweep range, so GM is omitted from expected.

crossover_hz.rationale: Unity-gain feedback → loop gain = A(f); crossover = GBW = 1 MHz. Allow 0.5-2× for numerical margin.

phase_margin_deg.rationale: Single dominant pole → -90° asymptote → PM ≈ 90°. The 100pF parasitic pole is at ~16 MHz, so its contribution at 1 MHz is minor. Require PM ≥ 60° (healthy).
